summary: Form 6-K filed by HDFC Bank Ltd. as a foreign private issuer under cover of US SEC rules. The filing merely notifies the NYSE of an upcoming board meeting on July 18, 2026 to consider and approve quarterly financial results, along with a trading blackout period for designated employees. No special situation event—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change—is reported. The filing is a routine quarterly report and meeting notice, not a special situation.
